package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestNavbarRoutesValidationSnapshotAndNativeDOM(t *testing.T) {
	for _, summary := range []string{"", " ", "bad\nname", string([]byte{0xff}), strings.Repeat("x", 257)} {
		if c, err := NewNavbarWithRoutes(fixtureNavbar(), summary); err == nil || c != nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid summary accepted")
		}
	}
	bad := fixtureNavbar()
	bad.Links[0].URL = "javascript:bad()"
	if c, err := NewNavbarWithRoutes(bad, "All links"); err == nil || c != nil {
		t.Fatal("base validation bypassed")
	}
	data := fixtureNavbar()
	data.CurrentKey = "projects"
	primary, err := NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	component, err := NewNavbarWithRoutes(data, `All <links> & routes`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data.Links[0].Label = "mutated primary"
	data.Notifications.URL = "/mutated"
	data.Account.Links[0].URL = "/mutated-account"
	markup := renderNavbar(t, component)
	if !strings.Contains(markup, renderNavbar(t, primary)) || strings.Contains(markup, "mutated") || !strings.Contains(markup, "All &lt;links&gt; &amp; routes") {
		t.Fatal("source/snapshot/escaping contract differs")
	}
	tree := navbarTree(t, markup)
	details := navbarNodes(tree, "details")
	if len(details) != 1 || len(navbarNodes(details[0], "summary")) != 1 || len(navbarNodes(details[0], "nav")) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("native route access structure differs")
	}
	links := navbarNodes(details[0], "a")
	want := []string{"/dashboard", "https://example.test/projects", "/notifications", "/profile", "/settings"}
	if len(links) != len(want) {
		t.Fatal("route inventory differs")
	}
	for i, link := range links {
		if navbarAttr(link, "href") != want[i] {
			t.Fatal("route order/destination differs")
		}
		current := navbarAttr(link, "aria-current")
		if i == 1 && current != "page" || i != 1 && current != "" {
			t.Fatal("current route differs")
		}
	}
	for _, tag := range []string{"script", "form", "button", "el-menu", "el-disclosure"} {
		if len(navbarNodes(details[0], tag)) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("native directory acquired a runtime or mutation")
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"hidden", "popover", "tabindex", "onload", "onclick"} {
		for _, attr := range details[0].Attr {
			if attr.Key == forbidden {
				t.Fatal("directory visibility/interaction has another owner")
			}
		}
	}
	data = fixtureNavbar()
	data.Account = nil
	data.Notifications = nil
	data.CurrentKey = ""
	component, err = NewNavbarWithRoutes(data, "All links")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	details = navbarNodes(navbarTree(t, renderNavbar(t, component)), "details")
	if len(navbarNodes(details[0], "a")) != 2 || strings.Contains(renderNavbar(t, component), "aria-current") {
		t.Fatal("optional route omission differs")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if !errors.Is(component.Render(ctx, &out), context.Canceled) || out.Len() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("cancellation ignored")
	}
	wantErr := errors.New("writer failure")
	if !errors.Is(component.Render(context.Background(), navbarFailWriter{wantErr}), wantErr) {
		t.Fatal("writer error lost")
	}
}

func TestNavbarRoutesRetainedRenders(t *testing.T) {
	typed := fixtureNavbar()
	typed.CurrentKey = "projects"
	long := fixtureNavbar()
	long.Links[0].Label = strings.Repeat("Long route name ", 15)
	long.Account.Links[0].Label = strings.Repeat("Long account route ", 12)
	minimal := fixtureNavbar()
	minimal.CurrentKey = ""
	minimal.Account = nil
	minimal.Notifications = nil
	for name, data := range map[string]Navbar{"typed": typed, "long": long, "minimal": minimal} {
		component, err := NewNavbarWithRoutes(data, "All navigation links")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		body := renderNavbar(t, component)
		if navbarRepairOutput != "" {
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(navbarRepairOutput, "repair-"+name+".html"), []byte(body), 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal("private render write failed")
			}
		}
	}
}

// Exercise the entire admitted input envelope, not only two unusually long labels.
func maximumNavbar() Navbar {
	text := func(prefix string, limit int) string {
		return prefix + strings.Repeat("x", limit-len(prefix))
	}
	url := func(path string, index int) string {
		return text(path+"?case="+strconv.Itoa(index)+"&pad=", 2048)
	}
	data := Navbar{
		IDPrefix: text("maximum-", 64), Label: text("Primary navigation ", 256),
		MobileLabel:   text("Open navigation ", 256),
		Brand:         NavbarBrand{LightURL: url("/assets/brand-light.svg", 0), DarkURL: url("/assets/brand-dark.svg", 0), Alt: text("Synthetic company ", 512)},
		Notifications: &NavbarDestination{Label: text("Notifications ", 256), URL: url("/notifications", 0)},
		Account:       &NavbarAccount{Label: text("Open account menu ", 256), ImageURL: url("/assets/avatar.jpg", 0)},
	}
	for i := 0; i < 12; i++ {
		data.Links = append(data.Links, NavbarLink{Key: text("route-"+strconv.Itoa(i)+"-", 64), Label: text("Primary "+strconv.Itoa(i)+" ", 256), URL: url("/dashboard", i)})
		data.Account.Links = append(data.Account.Links, NavbarDestination{Label: text("Account "+strconv.Itoa(i)+" ", 256), URL: url("/profile", i)})
	}
	data.CurrentKey = data.Links[11].Key
	return data
}

func TestNavbarRoutesMaximumAndRepeatedInstances(t *testing.T) {
	data := maximumNavbar()
	summary := "All navigation " + strings.Repeat("x", 256-len("All navigation "))
	component, err := NewNavbarWithRoutes(data, summary)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	body := renderNavbar(t, component)
	details := navbarNodes(navbarTree(t, body), "details")
	if len(details) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("maximum fixture lost native directory")
	}
	links := navbarNodes(details[0], "a")
	if len(details) != 1 || len(links) != 25 || len(summary) != 256 || len(data.IDPrefix) != 64 || len(data.Brand.Alt) != 512 {
		t.Fatal("maximum input fixture lost a declared boundary")
	}
	for i, link := range links {
		if len(navbarAttr(link, "href")) != 2048 || len(link.FirstChild.Data) != 256 {
			t.Fatal("maximum label/URL truncated")
		}
		if current := navbarAttr(link, "aria-current"); (i == 11 && current != "page") || (i != 11 && current != "") {
			t.Fatal("maximum current route differs")
		}
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*Navbar){
		"primary count":      func(n *Navbar) { n.Links = append(n.Links, n.Links[0]) },
		"account count":      func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links = append(n.Account.Links, n.Account.Links[0]) },
		"primary label":      func(n *Navbar) { n.Links[0].Label += "x" },
		"account label":      func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links[0].Label += "x" },
		"primary URL":        func(n *Navbar) { n.Links[0].URL += "x" },
		"account URL":        func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links[0].URL += "x" },
		"ID":                 func(n *Navbar) { n.IDPrefix += "x" },
		"key":                func(n *Navbar) { n.Links[0].Key += "x" },
		"alt":                func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.Alt += "x" },
		"brand URL":          func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.LightURL += "x" },
		"avatar URL":         func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.ImageURL += "x" },
		"landmark":           func(n *Navbar) { n.Label += "x" },
		"mobile label":       func(n *Navbar) { n.MobileLabel += "x" },
		"account name":       func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Label += "x" },
		"notification label": func(n *Navbar) { n.Notifications.Label += "x" },
		"notification URL":   func(n *Navbar) { n.Notifications.URL += "x" },
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			invalid := maximumNavbar()
			mutate(&invalid)
			if got, err := NewNavbarWithRoutes(invalid, summary); err == nil || got != nil {
				t.Fatal("over-bound repair input accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	if got, err := NewNavbarWithRoutes(data, summary+"x"); err == nil || got != nil {
		t.Fatal("over-bound summary accepted")
	}
	var repeated strings.Builder
	for i, id := range []string{"selected-a", "selected-b", "unselected"} {
		n := fixtureNavbar()
		n.IDPrefix, n.Label = id, id+" navigation"
		n.CurrentKey = n.Links[i%2].Key
		if i < 2 {
			component, err = NewNavbarWithRoutes(n, id+" all links")
		} else {
			component, err = NewNavbar(n)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		repeated.WriteString(`<section id="` + id + `">` + renderNavbar(t, component) + `</section>`)
	}
	tree := navbarTree(t, repeated.String())
	if len(navbarNodes(tree, "details")) != 2 || len(navbarNodes(tree, "nav")) != 5 {
		t.Fatal("repair selection leaked into base instance")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, tag := range []string{"section", "el-menu", "el-disclosure"} {
		for _, node := range navbarNodes(tree, tag) {
			id := navbarAttr(node, "id")
			// Elements assigns menu identity at runtime; only disclosure targets
			// and our specimen sections require a source-authored identifier.
			if tag == "el-menu" && id == "" {
				continue
			}
			if id == "" || seen[id] {
				t.Fatal("repeated instance has missing/duplicate identity")
			}
			seen[id] = true
		}
	}
	if navbarRepairOutput != "" {
		for name, value := range map[string]string{"repair-maximum.html": body, "repair-multiple.html": repeated.String()} {
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(navbarRepairOutput, name), []byte(value), 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal("private acceptance render write failed")
			}
		}
	}
}
